evidence: Changes core block connection and script checking logic in src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h.
rationale: Unifies single-threaded and multi-threaded script checking in ConnectBlock through CCheckQueue and fixes script cache population in TestBlockValidity. Eliminates the "confusing dual behavior" where CheckInputScripts executed inline or appended to pvChecks, and fixes a deficiency where multithreaded script checks in TestBlockValidity "never populated the script execution cache" because insertion was guarded with !pvChecks.
